user.title: Import project
user.description: Deploy Relay checks the repository and its deployment manifest without writing project files. For a private repository, provide a fine-grained read-only GitHub token.

data_description.repository: Use owner/repository or a full GitHub repository URL.
data_description.manifest_path: Path to the versioned Deploy Relay manifest in the repository. Usually deploy-relay.json.
data_description.github_token: Optional for public repositories. For private repositories, use a fine-grained token restricted to this repository with read access to metadata and contents.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure project
reconfigure.description: Choose whether to change repository access, select the Git source/version or open a fresh read-only preview.

repository_settings.title: Repository and access
repository_settings.description: Re-check the repository, manifest and credential. Leaving the token empty keeps the currently stored project token.

data_description.repository: Use owner/repository or a full GitHub repository URL.
data_description.manifest_path: Path to the versioned Deploy Relay manifest in the repository.
data_description.github_token: Enter a token only when it should replace the currently stored project token.
data_description.clear_github_token: Removes the stored token before checking the repository. Use this when the project is public or no longer needs authentication.

source_selection.title: Source and version
source_selection.description: Select a branch, tag or published GitHub release. Deploy Relay resolves the selection to an exact commit SHA and validates the deployment manifest from that commit.

data_description.source_choice: Draft releases are not offered. Use the manual commit option when you need an exact commit that is not listed.

manual_commit.title: Select commit
manual_commit.description: Enter a Git commit SHA. Deploy Relay resolves it to the canonical commit and validates the manifest from exactly that commit.

data_description.commit_sha: Use a hexadecimal Git commit id. Short GitHub commit ids are accepted and resolved to their canonical SHA.

preview.title: Deployment preview

init.title: Deploy Relay Agent options
init.description: Control how Deploy Relay Agent is integrated into the Home Assistant interface. Disabling the sidebar entry does not unload or disable the integration.

data.show_sidebar_panel: Show Deploy Relay Agent in the sidebar

data_description.show_sidebar_panel: When enabled, Deploy Relay Agent is available as an admin-only Home Assistant sidebar panel.
